questions.stem: The Durand Cup, one of the oldest football tournaments in Asia, is named after Sir Mortimer Durand. It is associated with which sport?
questions.explanation: The Durand Cup is a football tournament, one of the oldest in Asia (est. 1888), named after Sir Henry Mortimer Durand, the Foreign Secretary of British India. It was originally played in Shimla and later in Calcutta/Delhi. The tournament is organised by the Indian Army and is now played among I-League and ISL clubs.
questions.subject: general_knowledge

questions.stem: The Santosh Trophy is the national football championship of India, competed between the states and services. It is associated with which sport?
questions.explanation: The Santosh Trophy is India's national football championship for state associations and service departments (Army, Railways, SAI). It was instituted in 1941 and is named after Sir Manmatha Nath Roy Chowdhury, the Maharaja of Santosh, a former President of the Indian Football Association. Bengal and Services (Armed Forces) have won it most often.
questions.subject: general_knowledge

questions.stem: The Thomas Cup is the premier international team event for men, often called the 'World Cup' of its sport. Which sport does it represent?
questions.explanation: The Thomas Cup is the premier international team championship in men's badminton, organised by the Badminton World Federation (BWF). It was first held in 1949 and is named after Sir George Alan Thomas, former All England champion. The Uber Cup is its women's counterpart. Indonesia has won the Thomas Cup a record number of times.
questions.subject: general_knowledge

questions.stem: The Aga Khan Gold Cup Tournament, held annually in India, is associated with which sport?
questions.explanation: The Aga Khan Gold Cup is a premier international field hockey tournament held in India. It has been contested since the 1970s and features top national teams. It should not be confused with Polo, which also has Aga Khan-associated tournaments. The Aga Khan in this context relates to the Muslim Aga Khan sporting fund's support for field hockey.
questions.subject: general_knowledge

questions.stem: The Arjuna Award, instituted by the Government of India to recognise outstanding achievement in sports, was first awarded in which year?
questions.explanation: The Arjuna Award was instituted in 1961 by the Government of India. It is given to sportspersons for outstanding performance over four years and good sportsmanship. It is the second-highest sports honour in India, after the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award. The award includes a statuette, a certificate, and a cash prize.
questions.subject: general_knowledge

questions.stem: The Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award (formerly Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna) is India's highest sporting honour. It is given for:
options: B) The most spectacular and outstanding performance in sports
C) Best sports coach of the year
D) Best team performance in international competition
questions.explanation: The Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award (renamed from Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna in 2021) is given for the most spectacular and outstanding performance by a sportsperson over four years at the international level. The Dhyan Chand Award is for lifetime achievement. The Dronacharya Award is for coaches. The Khel Ratna carries ₹25 lakh in prize money.
questions.subject: general_knowledge

questions.stem: The Irani Cup in cricket is an annual match contested between:
options: A) North Zone vs South Zone
B) Mumbai vs Rest of India
C) Ranji Trophy champions vs Rest of India
D) India A vs India B
questions.explanation: The Irani Cup (officially the Irani Trophy) is contested between the Ranji Trophy champions and a Rest of India XI. It was first played in 1959–60 as part of the Golden Jubilee of the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI). The trophy is named after the late Z.R. Irani, a former Honorary Secretary and Treasurer of the BCCI.
questions.subject: general_knowledge

questions.stem: The Swaythling Cup is the premier World Team Championship trophy for men in which sport?
questions.explanation: The Swaythling Cup is the premier men's team trophy at the World Table Tennis Championships (WTTC), organised by the International Table Tennis Federation (ITTF). It was donated by Lady Swaythling in 1926. The Corbillon Cup is the women's equivalent. China has dominated both trophies for decades.
questions.subject: general_knowledge

questions.stem: The Major Dhyan Chand Award for Lifetime Achievement in Sports was instituted by the Government of India in which year?
questions.explanation: The Dhyan Chand Award for Lifetime Achievement in Sports was instituted in 2002, later renamed the Major Dhyan Chand Award. It is the highest lifetime achievement award in sports in India, given to sportspersons who have contributed to the promotion of sports even after retirement. Dhyan Chand was India's greatest field hockey player and a three-time Olympic gold medalist (1928, 1932, 1936).
questions.subject: general_knowledge

questions.stem: The Vijay Hazare Trophy is India's premier domestic one-day (50-over) cricket competition. It is associated with which sport?
questions.explanation: The Vijay Hazare Trophy is India's premier domestic List A (50-over) cricket tournament, named after Vijay Samuel Hazare, one of India's greatest batsmen. It is organised by the BCCI and features state associations. It is the 50-over domestic equivalent of the Ranji Trophy (4-day) and is used to scout talent for the India A team.
questions.subject: general_knowledge

questions.stem: The Corbillon Cup is the women's counterpart of the Swaythling Cup at the World Championships. It is associated with which sport?
questions.explanation: The Corbillon Cup is the premier women's team trophy at the World Table Tennis Championships (WTTC). It was donated by Marcel Corbillon, President of the French Table Tennis Federation, in 1934. Like the men's Swaythling Cup, it has been dominated by China. The WTTC has been held biennially since 1957.
questions.subject: general_knowledge

questions.stem: The Uber Cup is the world championship team event for women in which sport, and is the counterpart to the Thomas Cup?
questions.explanation: The Uber Cup is the premier international team championship in women's badminton, organised by BWF. It was first held in 1956 and is named after Betty Uber, a prominent English badminton player. The Thomas and Uber Cups are now held simultaneously every two years. China has won the Uber Cup a record number of times.
questions.subject: general_knowledge

questions.stem: The Merdeka Cup is one of Asia's oldest football tournaments (est. 1957). It is held in which country?
questions.explanation: The Merdeka Cup (officially the Pestabola Merdeka) is an international football tournament held in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. 'Merdeka' means 'independence' in Malay, and the tournament was first played in 1957 to commemorate Malaysian independence. It was one of Asia's most prestigious football tournaments before the AFC Asian Cup grew in prominence.
questions.subject: general_knowledge

questions.stem: The Jules Rimet Trophy was the original FIFA World Cup. It was permanently awarded to Brazil in 1970 because:
options: A) Brazil hosted the tournament that year
B) Brazil won the trophy for the third time
C) Brazil had the most goals in the tournament's history
D) The trophy was first made in Brazil
questions.explanation: Under the original rules, any nation that won the FIFA World Cup three times would permanently keep the Jules Rimet Trophy. Brazil achieved this feat in 1970 (Mexico) by winning their third title, having previously won in 1958 (Sweden) and 1962 (Chile). A new FIFA World Cup Trophy was commissioned from 1974 onward. The Jules Rimet trophy was later stolen in Brazil in 1983 and never recovered.
questions.subject: general_knowledge

questions.stem: The Ranji Trophy, India's premier first-class cricket tournament, was first played in which season?
questions.explanation: The Ranji Trophy was instituted in 1934 by the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) and first played in the 1934–35 season. It is named after Kumar Shri Ranjitsinhji (K.S. Ranjitsinhji), the Maharaja Jam Sahib of Nawanagar, who played for England and was one of cricket's most elegant batsmen. Mumbai (erstwhile Bombay) holds the record for most Ranji titles.
questions.subject: general_knowledge

questions.stem: The Deodhar Trophy (now discontinued) was a domestic cricket competition in India where matches were played in which format?
options: D) Cricket — 50-over, between zonal teams and India A
questions.explanation: The Deodhar Trophy was a domestic 50-over List A cricket tournament in India, contested between teams representing the five zones (North, South, East, West, Central) and India A. It was named after Prof. D.B. Deodhar, a veteran cricketer. The BCCI discontinued it in favour of other domestic tournaments. The Duleep Trophy (four-day) is the other major zonal cricket tournament.
questions.subject: general_knowledge

questions.stem: The Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award was renamed from 'Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna' in which year?
questions.explanation: In August 2021, the Government of India renamed the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award to the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award, honouring India's greatest field hockey player. The decision was announced by Prime Minister Narendra Modi following public sentiment expressed on National Sports Day (29 August — Dhyan Chand's birthday). Dhyan Chand won three Olympic gold medals for India (1928, 1932, 1936).
questions.subject: general_knowledge

questions.stem: The Davis Cup in tennis is the world's largest annual international team competition. Ties are played in what format?
options: A) Round-robin league among all nations
B) Knockout ties between national teams (home/away or neutral)
C) Single-elimination Grand Slam style bracket
D) League stage followed by a six-nation finals
questions.explanation: The Davis Cup, organised by the International Tennis Federation (ITF), is contested through knockout ties between national teams. Each tie traditionally consists of four singles rubbers and one doubles rubber (best-of-5 format). Since 2019, the Finals have adopted a Finals Week format. The competition began in 1900 as a tie between the USA and Great Britain.
questions.subject: general_knowledge

questions.stem: The Subroto Cup International Football Tournament, one of Asia's largest football competitions for youth, is contested by:
questions.explanation: The Subroto Cup is an international school-level football tournament held annually in New Delhi, organised by the Indian Air Force. It is named after Air Marshal Subroto Mukerjee, the first Chief of Air Staff of the Indian Air Force and a football enthusiast. The tournament began in 1960 and is now one of Asia's largest youth football tournaments, with teams from over 70 countries.
questions.subject: general_knowledge

questions.stem: The Nehru Trophy Boat Race, one of Kerala's most famous water festivals featuring snake boats (Chundan Vallam), is held at:
questions.explanation: The Nehru Trophy Boat Race is held on Punnamada Lake near Alappuzha (Alleppey) in Kerala, on the second Saturday of August every year. It was instituted in 1952 in honour of Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru, who attended the Onam boat race in 1952 and donated a trophy. The race features Chundan Vallam (snake boats) — long, ornate crafts rowed by over 100 oarsmen.
questions.subject: general_knowledge

questions.stem: The Maulana Abul Kalam Azad (MAKA) Trophy is given annually to which category of institution for best overall sports performance?
options: A) University with the best overall sports performance
B) Best school in national-level sports
C) Best state in the National Games
questions.explanation: The Maulana Abul Kalam Azad Trophy is given to the university that has the best overall performance across all sports at the All India Inter-University Sports Competitions, organised by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU). It has been awarded since 1956–57. Panjab University (Chandigarh) has won this trophy most number of times.
questions.subject: general_knowledge

questions.stem: The Beighton Cup is one of the oldest field hockey tournaments in the world (est. 1895). It is associated with which sport?
questions.explanation: The Beighton Cup is an international field hockey tournament held in Kolkata (formerly Calcutta), named after Sir Charles Beighton, the then-Lieutenant Governor of Bengal. First played in 1895, it is one of the oldest hockey tournaments in the world. Calcutta (now Kolkata) Custom House AC and Indian Railways have been frequent champions.
questions.subject: general_knowledge

questions.stem: Wimbledon is the oldest and most prestigious Grand Slam tennis tournament in the world. In which year was the first Wimbledon Championship held?
questions.explanation: The first Wimbledon Championship was held in 1877 at the All England Croquet and Lawn Tennis Club, Wimbledon, London. Spencer Gore won the inaugural men's singles title. Women's singles was added in 1884. Wimbledon is the only Grand Slam still played on grass courts and is known for its strict white clothing rule.
questions.subject: general_knowledge

questions.stem: The Ranji Trophy is named after K.S. Ranjitsinhji (Ranjit). Although he was an Indian prince, he played Test cricket for which country?
questions.explanation: Kumar Shri Ranjitsinhji played 15 Test matches for England (1896–1902), not India (India did not have Test status then). He is celebrated as one of cricket's most elegant batsmen. He was the Maharaja Jam Sahib of Nawanagar (Gujarat). His nephew Duleepsinhji also played for England, and the Duleep Trophy is named after him.
questions.subject: general_knowledge

questions.stem: In the FIFA World Cup, the 'Golden Boot' (Adidas Golden Boot) is awarded to:
options: A) The team with the best goal difference in the tournament
B) The best goalkeeper in the tournament
C) The top goal scorer of the tournament
D) The most creative midfielder in the tournament
questions.explanation: The Golden Boot (Adidas Golden Boot) is awarded to the top goal scorer in the FIFA World Cup. In case of a tie in goals, it is decided by assists, then by minutes played. The Golden Glove is given to the best goalkeeper, and the Golden Ball to the best player overall. Miroslav Klose holds the all-time World Cup scoring record with 16 goals.
questions.subject: general_knowledge
